item.name: San Diego Beach Yoga (Private Class)
item.description:
#Get Your Dream Beach Yoga Experience!

Embark on a deeply restorative yoga journey with your very own private yoga session on the beach.
					
Meet us at one of San Diego's most beautiful beaches and work with your own dedicated Yoga Teacher for class unlike any other.

Dig your toes into the sand as you stretch deep, releasing stress and stored tension. Open your heart and clear your mind with powerful breath work to sound of ocean waves in the distance.

Get ready for a one of kind yoga experience that you'll never forget!

**Ready to Book? Pick your desired date & time from the calendar and reserve your spot today!**

##Session Includes:
- 1.5-2hr Custom, Private Yoga Class with an Experienced Teacher
- Hatha Yoga, Restorative, Traditional
- Yoga on the beach!
- Soul-Charging Breath-Work
- Deep Guided Meditation
- Complimentary Yoga Mat/Blanket Rentals

##Difficulty
- All Levels Welcome

##What to Bring
- Water Bottle
- Sun Protection
- Comfy Clothes
- Good Shoes

##About Your Hosts
Vita Pura Yoga has grown from a humble living room yoga studio to a top yoga retreat and wellness company (TripAdvisor, 2022/23). Their unique combination of traditional yoga science with soulful hiking has helped thousands of students blossom and grow. Now home to a team teachers, healers and guides, they deliver specular results to students every day. If you're looking for a special spiritual experience in San Diego, you've found it.

##How It Works
We make this experience as easy as possible.  Just meet your teacher at the beach parking lot. Your teacher will have yoga mats ready to lend for the class.

##Is This Good For Groups?
This is perfect for groups of all sizes, from solo travelers to groups of 15+.  Enjoy a custom experience designed to meet your groups level, goals and needs with expert attention from our amazing teachers.

##Do I Need Past Yoga Experience?
All ages and levels are welcome, no experience required - just an open mind and desire to grow. Your teacher will customize the session based on your unique needs and level.

##What Kind of Yoga Is This?
We teach authentic, traditional Hatha yoga science.  The practice is true to its holistic Eastern roots as apposed to Western "fitness yoga".  You'll learn to move energy within the body through invigorating Pranayama (Breath Work) alongside restorative asana postures and deep meditation.  In doing so, you'll be able to release stress, trauma and old wounds, creating space for healing.

##What Do Our Clients Say?
- "I am an average yogi, my husband has no experience with yoga at all... **I am so glad I booked this, it was the highlight of our trip!**"
-Chrissy

- "**I had a truly transformational and peaceful experience** My guide led me to some amazing Breath-Work where I embodied a sense of inner peace that I have a never experienced."
-Sherri

- "Our yoga experience was incredible - the views were 10/10 as well as our session. **Can’t recommend this experience enough!!**"
-Spencer

- "The overall experience was amazing on all fronts. Reservation process was simple and communication was excellent. Reminders and meeting point GPS was provided prior to scheduled event...**and yoga was perfect.** "
-Charlie

- "Where do I start? **I booked this tour with some girlfriends and we had an amazing experience.**...he was an excellent yoga instructor. He provided modifications and a better understanding of yoga."
-Denisse

**Don't miss this once in a lifetime experience. Create a memory that won't just leave you charged, it'll leave you transformed.**
item.booking_notes:
#Congratulations, Your Private Beach Yoga Class is Booked!  
Take a deep breath and feel excited.  You've taken a powerful step.  This is not just a simple yoga class, it is a transformational healing experience.

Our yoga sessions are designed to provide you with complete rejuvenation, harnessing the beauty and nourishing energy of the Pacific Ocean with a charging yoga practice on the beach.

##How Does it All Work?##

All you have to do is meet your teacher at the designated beach parking area. Your teacher will provide yoga mats/blankets for you. Take a short walk to the sandy shores and begin your practice!

We'll focus on a session both restorative and holistic, fusing together a Breath Work and Asana practice. All under the careful guidance of a highly trained teacher.  

If you are coming from a Western yoga background, it is important to note that this is a traditional, more Eastern yoga experience.  Expect to slow things down, go deep within and move some energy!

**This experience is about dissolving the ego, gaining presence and then moving forward in life with fresh new energy.**

##What to Bring:##
- Comfy, Appropriate Clothing
- **Water Bottle (Most Important!)**
- Sun Glasses (you may be facing the setting sun)
- Sun Protection (The beach is exposed!)
- A Light Snack (if needed)

**We'll provide you with complementary yoga mat/blankets for the day.**

##Safety First##
Your safety is always our #1 priority during this experience. While yoga is generally considered to be very safe, please be aware that there are some inherent risks practicing yoga outdoors. Use caution and always stay on the trail.

##How to Prepare##
- 1) Take a moment to set your intention and write it down.  Ask yourself, "in what ways would I like to grow, gain or release from this experience?"  There is no right or wrong answer.  Just put it into words and save it for later.

- 2) Add your appointment to your personal calendar so you don't miss it!

- 3) Share our yoga page with your group (if applicable) so that they know what to expect.

##Weather##
San Diego is known for its year round beautiful weather. While this is mostly true, there are still times of intense heat during the Summer, and chilly days during the winter.

**Please prepare with plenty of water, warmth or sun protection if needed.**

##Beach Etiquette##
- Share the beach - be safe and respectful.  
- Practice mindfulness and awareness at all times.
- Pack it in, pack it out and leave no trace.

##Cell Phone Usage##
While we encourage a mostly device free experience, taking pictures is of course welcome.  Please save your social media posts and shares for after the session however, and allow yourself to be fully present for the experience. 

##Gratuities##
It is customary to tip your teacher/guide if you have enjoyed your experience with us. Typical tips and gratuities range between 15 and 25 percent, depending on how you enjoyed and were impacted by your experience. Our teachers very much appreciate your generosity and are there to ensure you have the most incredible time with us possible.

##Questions/Contact##
We're here to help you in preparing for this experience in every way we can. If you have a question that comes up before your yoga hike, please reach out to us via email or simply give us a call/text.  We'll normally get back to you within 24hrs at most.  

**Thank You & Namaste!**
**Vita Pura Yoga**
**928-707-2408**
item.cancellation_notes:
#Flexible Cancellation Policy:
Life is unpredictable, we know. If something comes up and you must cancel your yoga hiking session we are happy to provide a full deposit refund so long as you let us know 14 days prior to the start date.

If a cancellation is made within 13 days of the tour start date, your deposit will be allowed to stay on file as credit towards rescheduling another session with us in the future.

Any cancellations made within 48hrs of the start date are non-refundable and subject to being charged full price.

start_location.name: Scripps Beach
start_location.note:
Park at the beach access parking lot for Scripps and buy your parking permit. The lot is less than a mile North of La Jolla Shores. There is a cafe called Caroline's nearby. 

**Weekends and Holidays:** Public parking is available in lots **P002 and P003**, and permits can be purchased at the pay station in lot P003.

**Parking can be challenging at all times in La Jolla. We recommend arriving 15 minutes early to ensure your spot.**

Parking on the weekdays can be very limited and street side may be required.

**Alternative Streetside Parking**: Consider parking along Discovery Way or La Jolla Shores Dr and walking to the parking lot. 

Note: If parking is too challenging your teacher may contact you to arrange an alternative meeting location.
